sources.quote: TOI-700 e is the second outermost known exoplanet orbiting TOI-700, a red dwarf star in the constellation of Dorado.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-700. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
